We Are Different

Compiled and Illustrated by Good Friends Children's Books

summary_zh: 本页为绘本《不一样的我们》的封面，主题为‘胎生和卵生’，由好朋友童书编绘，化学工业出版社出版，画面中央有一只穿着绿色衣服、坐在椅子上吃饼干的小猪。
本页显示绘本的开始页，画面中央有一只穿着浅绿色睡衣、背后背着格子枕头的小猪，上方写着“故事开始”，标志着故事的正式开启。

page_text_ocr_zh: 春风吹绿了小草，吹开了小花，也吹醒了农场里的小动物……
page_text_en: The spring breeze turned the grass green, bloomed the flowers, and woke up the little animals on the farm...
summary_zh: 春风唤醒了农场里的小动物们，画面中猪、羊、牛、鸡、鸭等动物在草地上活动，有的休息，有的准备食物，营造出温暖的春日氛围。

page_text_ocr_zh:
每天早上都会去池塘游泳的鹅妈妈，今天出门时突然觉得肚子有点不舒服。
“难道是小宝宝等不及要出来了吗？”鹅妈妈自言自语道。
没过一会儿，鹅妈妈就产下了一颗蛋。
知道更多
①母鹅每次产蛋1颗，一年能产蛋30～40颗。
②母鹅下蛋前，腹部饱满、行动迟缓，一般暂时不会再吃东西。
page_text_en:
Every morning, the goose mother would go swimming in the pond. Today, when she went out, she suddenly felt a bit uncomfortable in her stomach.
"Could it be that the baby can't wait to come out?" the goose mother murmured to herself.
After a short while, the goose mother laid an egg.
Know More
① A female goose lays one egg at a time and can produce 30 to 40 eggs per year.
② Before laying eggs, a female goose has a full abdomen, moves slowly, and usually stops eating temporarily.
summary_zh: 鹅妈妈感到肚子不舒服，自言自语猜测宝宝要出生，随后产下了一颗蛋，其他动物在旁围观。页面下方附有关于母鹅产蛋的科普知识。

page_text_ocr_zh:
猪妈妈挺着大肚子正好路过，得知鹅妈妈生了宝宝，赶紧探进头来看看。
“恭喜恭喜，不过，您的宝宝可真奇怪，一点儿都不像您。”
“那是因为我的宝宝是卵生的，现在它还只是一颗蛋，等它在蛋里吸收好营养，出来后就像我了。”
知道更多
动物的受精卵在母体外独立发育的生殖方式叫“卵生”。受精卵慢慢变成胚胎，
胚胎发育过程中所需的营养物质全部来自于卵本身。
page_text_en:
The pig mom, with her big belly, happened to pass by and learned that the goose mom had given birth to a baby. She quickly peeked in to take a look.
"Congratulations! But your baby is so strange—it doesn’t look like you at all."
"That’s because my baby is oviparous. Right now, it’s just an egg. Once it absorbs all the nutrients inside the egg, it will look like me when it hatches."
Learn More
The reproductive method where a fertilized egg develops independently outside the mother’s body is called "oviparity." The fertilized egg gradually becomes an embryo, and all the nutrients needed for embryonic development come from the egg itself.
summary_zh: 猪妈妈路过看到鹅妈妈刚生下蛋，觉得宝宝奇怪不像鹅妈妈，鹅妈妈解释宝宝是卵生，现在是蛋，孵化后才会像自己。页面右侧科普了‘卵生’的定义和特点。

page_text_ocr_zh:
猪妈妈一边和鹅妈妈聊着天，一边吃着美味的食物。鹅妈妈关心地说：“我怎么觉得，您的饭量比平时大了不少。”猪妈妈笑着回答：“是啊，我们哺乳动物一般是胎生的，得靠腹中的胎盘给肚子里的小宝宝输送营养。我必须得比平时多吃一些，这样小宝宝才能获得充足的营养！”
知道更多
①哺乳动物一般为胎生。
②胎生是指动物受精卵在母体内发育到一定阶段后才脱离母体的生殖方式。受精卵发育成胚胎后着床在子宫内壁，通过胎盘从母体获得营养，直至出生。
page_text_en:
Pig Mommy was chatting with Goose Mommy while eating delicious food. Goose Mommy said worriedly, "I feel like your appetite is much bigger than usual." Pig Mommy smiled and replied, "That's right. We mammals are generally viviparous. We need to rely on the placenta in our abdomen to deliver nutrients to the baby in my belly. I must eat more than usual so that my baby can get enough nutrition!"
Learn More
① Mammals are generally viviparous.
② Viviparity refers to the reproductive method where the fertilized egg develops inside the mother's body to a certain stage before leaving the mother's body. After the fertilized egg develops into an embryo, it implants into the uterine wall and obtains nutrients from the mother through the placenta until birth.
summary_zh: 猪妈妈和鹅妈妈在户外野餐时聊天，鹅妈妈关心猪妈妈饭量变大，猪妈妈解释自己是哺乳动物，需要通过胎盘为腹中胎儿输送营养，因此要多吃。页面右侧科普了胎生的定义和特点。

page_text_ocr_zh:
日子一天一天地过去，他俩好奇地
来到了屋外，在农场的草地上相遇了。
春风、春雨、阳光不停地滋润着农场的草地。当草地上开满了美丽的小花
时，小鹅钻出了蛋壳，小猪也顺利出生了。
知道更多
①鹅蛋的孵化期是31天左右，孵化温度是36～37℃。
②猪妈妈的孕期是110～120天。刚出生的小猪很快就能站立了，然后它们会跌跌撞撞地到妈妈身边去吃奶。
page_text_en:
Days passed one by one, and the two of them curiously
went outside to meet on the farm's grassy field.
Spring breeze, spring rain, and sunshine kept nourishing the farm's grassland. When the grassland was covered with beautiful little flowers,
the little goose hatched from its eggshell, and the little pig was also born safely.
Know More
① The incubation period for goose eggs is about 31 days, with an incubation temperature of 36–37℃.
② A pig mother's gestation period is 110–120 days. Newborn piglets can stand up quickly, and then they wobble over to their mother to nurse.
summary_zh: 猪妈妈和鹅妈妈在农场草地上相遇，此时小鹅已破壳而出，小猪也顺利出生。页面下方补充了鹅蛋孵化期和猪妈妈孕期的科普知识。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“你好，我叫小鹅。”
“你好，我叫小猪。”
“小鹅，把你的奶瓶拿出来，我们来比赛喝奶，看谁喝得快。”
“可我不喝奶啊。小猪，不如带上你的蛋壳，我们一起去吃青草吧！”
“可是，蛋壳是什么？我没有啊！”小猪回答道。
“哇，你好奇怪！我不要跟你做朋友！”小鹅、小猪同时说道。
page_text_en:
"Hello, I'm Little Goose."
"Hello, I'm Little Pig."
"Little Goose, take out your bottle, let's race to see who can drink milk faster."
"But I don't drink milk. Little Pig, why don't you bring your eggshell, and let's go eat grass together!"
"But what's an eggshell? I don't have one!" Little Pig replied.
"Wow, you're so strange! I don't want to be friends with you!" Little Goose and Little Pig said at the same time.
summary_zh: 小鹅和小猪初次见面，因饮食习惯和身体特征不同而产生误解，彼此觉得对方奇怪，最终都表示不想做朋友。

page_text_ocr_zh:
为了找到新朋友，小鹅想出了一个办法，他遇到谁都会问一句：“你刚出生的时候，叫什么？”
我刚出生的时候叫鸡蛋。
我刚出生的时候叫鸭蛋。
我刚出生的时候叫鸽子蛋。
“太好了，都是蛋，和我一样！”小鹅说，“我刚出生的时候叫鹅蛋，请你们做我的朋友吧！”
知道更多
鸡、鸭、鹅、鸽子等家禽，都是会下蛋的卵生动物。
page_text_en:
To find new friends, the little goose came up with an idea. He would ask everyone he met: 'What were you called when you were born?'
I was called an egg when I was born.
I was called a duck egg when I was born.
I was called a pigeon egg when I was born.
'Great! We're all eggs, just like me!' said the little goose. 'I was called a goose egg when I was born. Please be my friends!'
Know More
Chickens, ducks, geese, and pigeons are all egg-laying oviparous animals.
summary_zh: 小鹅为了交朋友，询问其他小动物出生时的名字，发现鸡、鸭、鸽子都是从蛋里出生的，于是认为自己和它们一样，邀请它们做朋友。页面下方科普了家禽是卵生动物的知识。

page_text_ocr_zh:
为了能交到和自己一样的朋友，小猪也想出了一个问题。
“你是从蛋里钻出来的吗？”
“不是，我是从妈妈肚子里生出来的小羊。”
“我是从妈妈肚子里生出来的小牛。”
“我是从妈妈肚子里生出来的小马。”
“太好了，我找到和自己出生方式一样的朋友啦！”小猪开心地说。
知道更多
猪、羊、牛、马等家畜，都是胎生的哺乳动物。
page_text_en:
In order to make friends who are like himself, the little pig came up with a question.
"Were you hatched from an egg?"
"No, I was born from my mom's tummy. I'm a little lamb."
"I was born from my mom's tummy. I'm a little calf."
"I was born from my mom's tummy. I'm a little horse."
"Great! I've found friends who were born the same way as me!" the little pig said happily.
Know More
Pigs, sheep, cows, and horses are all mammals that give birth to live young.
summary_zh: 小猪为了找到和自己出生方式相同的朋友，询问小羊、小牛和小马，得知它们都是从妈妈肚子里生出来的，于是开心地认为找到了同类朋友。页面下方科普了猪、羊、牛、马等家畜是胎生哺乳动物的知识。

page_text_ocr_zh:
小鹅找到了小蛇、小乌龟、
小青蛙、小蜥蜴、小蜻蜓……
小猪找到了小狗、小猫、小
老鼠、小兔子、小猴子……
走出农场，他们又找到
了其他朋友。
知道更多
①鸟类、爬行类、两栖类、昆
虫等大多是卵生动物。
②绝大部分哺乳动物都是胎生
动物。
page_text_en:
The little goose found the little snake, little turtle,
 little frog, little lizard, little dragonfly...
 The little pig found the little dog, little cat, little
 mouse, little rabbit, little monkey...
 Leaving the farm, they found
 other friends.
 Know More
 ① Birds, reptiles, amphibians, and insects are mostly oviparous animals.
 ② Most mammals are viviparous animals.
summary_zh: 小鹅和小猪离开农场，分别找到了更多与自己出生方式相同的动物朋友，画面展示了它们与新朋友的互动场景，并补充了关于卵生和胎生动物的科普知识。

page_text_ocr_zh:
于是，他们用栅栏把草地分成了两半。
朋友们又唱又跳地走啊走，来到草地上做游戏。
“他们和我们不一样，别和他们一起玩！”小猪告诉身边的朋友们。
“你们和我们不一样，我们也不要和你们玩。”小鹅和朋友们生气了。
page_text_en:
So, they used a fence to divide the meadow into two halves.
Friends danced and skipped along, arriving at the meadow to play games.
“They’re different from us, don’t play with them!” the little pig told his friends.
“You’re different from us, we don’t want to play with you either,” the little goose and friends got angry.
summary_zh: 小猪和小鹅分别带着各自的朋友们来到草地，因认为彼此不同而拒绝交往，最终用栅栏将草地分成两半，各自玩耍。

page_text_ocr_zh:
没一会儿，望着干枯的水洼，口渴的卵生宝宝犯了难。
“嗯……请问你们能给我们一点儿水喝吗？”隔着栅栏，小鹅很不好意思地探头问道。
“我们有奶，分一些给你们吧。”胎生宝宝们纷纷将奶瓶递过了围栏。
“你们真好！”小鹅和朋友们感激地说。
知道更多
乳汁里含有丰富的营养和大量的水分，
小婴儿可以通过喝奶满足水分和营养的需要。
page_text_en:
After a while, looking at the dried-up puddle, the egg-laying babies felt thirsty and were in trouble.
"Um... could you please give us a little water to drink?" asked the little goose, shyly peeking over the fence.
"We have milk, let's share some with you," said the live-born babies, passing bottles over the fence.
"You're so kind!" the little goose and friends said gratefully.
Know More
Milk contains rich nutrients and plenty of water.
Babies can meet their water and nutritional needs by drinking milk.
summary_zh: 小鹅和卵生动物朋友们因口渴向栅栏另一边的胎生动物求助，胎生动物们分享了奶瓶，双方因此互相感激，画面展现了不同出生方式动物间的互助与友善。

page_text_ocr_zh:
又过了一会儿，太阳公公藏了起来，天空突然下起雨来。
雨点噼里啪啦地落在胎生宝宝们的头上。
“请问，你们可以借雨伞给我们吗？”小猪小声地问。
“没问题。”卵生宝宝们把一些蛋壳伞齐刷刷地递了过去。
“你们真好！”小猪和朋友们感激地说。
page_text_en:
A little while later, the sun hid, and suddenly it started to rain.
Raindrops pattered down on the heads of the viviparous babies.
"Excuse me, could you lend us some umbrellas?" the little pig asked quietly.
"No problem." The oviparous babies handed over some eggshell umbrellas one after another.
"You're so kind!" the little pig and friends said gratefully.
summary_zh: 天空突然下雨，胎生动物们向卵生动物们借雨伞，卵生动物们用蛋壳伞帮助了他们，双方互相感激。

page_text_ocr_zh:
不久，雨停了。
卵生宝宝们想玩“奶茶甜品店”的游戏，可是缺少奶。胎生宝宝们想玩“跷跷板”和“荡秋千”，可却找不到制作材料。
他们的目光同时望向了栅栏的另一边。
page_text_en:
Soon, the rain stopped.
The oviparous babies wanted to play the 'Milk Tea Dessert Shop' game, but they were missing milk. The viviparous babies wanted to play 'Seesaw' and 'Swing', but couldn't find the materials.
Their eyes turned simultaneously toward the other side of the fence.
summary_zh: 雨停后，卵生动物们想玩奶茶甜品店游戏但缺奶，胎生动物们想玩跷跷板和荡秋千却缺材料，双方都望向了栅栏另一边，暗示即将发生互动。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“对啊，虽然我们不一样，但可以取长补短，互相帮助。”
大家齐声说。
说干就干！胎生宝宝和卵生宝宝一起拆掉了栅栏！
虽然大家不一样，但却能够开心地在同一片蓝天下生活，在同一个农场中玩耍！
page_text_en:
"Right! Even though we are different, we can learn from each other and help one another."
Everyone said in unison.
Let's get to it! The babies born from mothers and the babies born from eggs together took down the fence!
Even though we are different, we can still happily live under the same blue sky and play together on the same farm!
summary_zh: 胎生动物和卵生动物们决定拆除隔开彼此的栅栏，共同在农场里快乐地玩耍和生活，体现了不同出生方式动物间的团结与友爱。
